title: Treasure Hunt
subtitle: Secrets are hidden in the seams. Stretch out your hand, a bit further.

items.text: Treasure Hunt
Joint Committee of SF

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: The official letter of appointment from the Foundation.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Congratulations, Vertin. After the long evaluation period and the re-examination ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: The Storm Reformation: Manpower and Discipline has been officially approved by the Pax Security Council.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Team Timekeeper is now a legitimate independent department.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: You are now granted more flexible autonomy and independent budget.
They’ve been waiting in the suitcase for this document for far too long.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What was that? Did you say budget?!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Does that mean the Foundation will buy … assign me a new ship?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Unfortunately, "independent" means "doesn't rely on others."

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I can apply for a ship for you, but it's not guaranteed.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Tsk, misers!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Fine. Not that I wanted an obsolete ship painted in grayish shepherd check.
Regulus mumbles and walks away. She has entirely lost interest in this conversation.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: However, the price of passing that bill is to let the Foundation keep its authority to discipline unregistered arcanists.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: The arcanists who have been and will be assigned to Timekeeper's team will be put through a risk assessment procedure carried out by the Foundation.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Those who are in lower-risk categories only need to receive primary artificial somnambulism training, while the high-risk ones will go to the School of Discipline.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: But I will make sure they will be registered as members of Team Timekeeper when they enroll.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I see. I have only one question.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Are you still our point of contact for the Foundation, Madam Z?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Yes, of course.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Then I have no further questions.
A smile breaks on Madam Z's lip.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Meanwhile, Team Timekeeper can apply for secondment from the Foundation, Laplace, and Zeno, if necessary.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: You can check this file for more details.
Ms. Z hands over a supplemental clause of considerable thickness.
Fortunately, there are other things in more dire need of being checked for now.
What's our mission?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: It stays the same—keep investigating the "Storm" and Manus Vindictae.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: You can make your own plans of action. The Foundation only needs a monthly report on the result.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: You are the first-in-command, Vertin.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Okay.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: You already have a target, I assume?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: That base the Manus used to keep its Olitiaus four years ago. It has never been reversed by the "Storm."

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'd like to investigate that place again.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: So you've been there many times.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Well, that'd make a good start for Team Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: I'll arrange for some people to meet you at the base.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Heh heh ... I think you'll have a great time together.
Olitiau Base

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh. The fog is thick here. A-choo!
The mist hangs heavy in the valley, and the temperature is somewhat uncomfortable for those accustomed to the suitcase.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It used to be the nest of Olitiaus, a kind of creature resting in valleys with abundant water resources.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What's more, it's winter now.
The leaves are indeed covered with a thin skin of frost.
Regulus clicks her tongue and eyes the fog-shrouded Gate of Zeno.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So, why do I have to be the errand girl? The Foundation wasn't even planning to give me a ship!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Ms. Sonetto is going through the procedures in the headquarters to transfer herself to Team Timekeeper.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Ms. Druvis and Sotheby are on a break, for they have spent much time and energy clearing the woods and repairing the Foundation's square.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Ms. Lilya has been given an administrative penalty because she broke into the Rehabilitation Center not long ago.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: This leads us to the current situation, where only the Captain and this APPLe are able to act freely.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So in the end, was I, the renowned rocking pirate, the only one who didn't cause any damage to the Foundation buildings?!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ugh! I have never felt so humiliated in my life!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You're not planning on destroying this place now, are you, Regulus?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: No, no. Emm?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hey, see who's here! Lilya and a stranger!
Next to the rusty iron door, Lilya squats on her hunkers, looking extremely bored.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: What took you so long? Fell into a gutter?
A graceful stranger is standing next to her.
Hello, Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: My name is Moissan. My employee ID is SF27602191908238X. I believe Madam Z has told you about me.

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: I am now an official member of your team.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ms. Moissan, welcome to the team. Madam Z said you're an excellent tutor in arcanum.

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: She's too kind to say so. In fact, I have a lot to learn from you.

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: Also, thank you for taking good care of Ms. Sotheby.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hold on, you know Sotheby?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: According to Madam Z, Ms. Moissan used to be Sotheby's private teacher.

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: It is a long story.

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: Let Ms. Lilya give us an introduction to the base first. As the field operator, she knows this place better.
Ms. Moissan smiles toward the flying witch beside her, who has started to yawn.
Someone clearly has grown tired of this humdrum small talk.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hah! After I got promoted and transferred to the headquarters, those exciting outbound missions have been removed from my schedule.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: In short, although it's called the base ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: The only place unaffected by the "Storm" is a narrow, 20-meter-long corridor, no larger than a hunter's lodge.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: My former fellows had already searched this place from top to bottom.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Those Laplace dudes had even sent in their lab dogs to search here inch by inch. Found nothing but some excrement of the Olitiaus and the dogs' own poop.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: There might be some clues that are invisible.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Regulus is a specialist in optical arcane skills, maybe she can find something.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: A specialist? Ahem ... Well, I'll take that as a compliment.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: But for the record, compared to searching, hiding treasures is more of a pirate's lot!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So if it were up to me to hide treasures in this place ...
Regulus walks into the depths of the river valley.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Please hold on for a second, Captain Regulus.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The fog seems abnormally thick.
Regulus halts and hesitates. Slowly, she turns her head.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Whaaa! Ambush! Ambush! These prats nearly shot my hat off!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Lucky you. They hit the jackpot right away.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hmm. There shouldn't be any ambush in this place.

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: Easy, Ms. Regulus. Please carefully retreat to my side!

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: Ms. Timekeeper, please cover us!
Unknown attackers. Everyone, be careful!
TO BE CONTINUED…
